links.outcome: Distribution difference between local mineworker CXRs and international CXR datasets
links.effect: Dimensionality reduction showed local silica-exposed mineworker CXRs form a distinct cluster separate from international images, indicating dataset shift.
links.quote: Dimensionality reduction analysis produced visual mappings that demonstrate how local CXRs form a distinct cluster, separate from international images.

links.outcome: CAD detection performance under reduced image resolution, TB versus silicosis
links.effect: Reducing image resolution disproportionately degraded silicosis detection relative to TB; no numbers reported in abstract.
links.quote: We also found that, relative to TB, reducing image resolution disproportionately degraded silicosis detection.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests CAD models on a local cohort of silica-exposed ex-miners versus international datasets to evaluate transferability, bias, and the impact of local adaptation/dataset curation.
